title: What can you do with the free API? A comparison of Gemini Notebook (formerly NotebookLM) MCP and PDF addition limits
snippet:

The API itself is free during the preview period, but the creation limits vary depending on the subscription tier of your personal Google account (Source: [Rate limits and quotas](https://developers.google.com/notebook/docs/rate-limits), checked on: 2026-11-21).

title: Gemini Notebook (formerly NotebookLM) API: Key and Pricing
snippet:
No, not for personal accounts. Google’s only documented Gemini Notebook API belongs to Gemini Notebook Enterprise on Google Cloud, and its setup steps require Enterprise licenses before you make a single call ([Google Cloud](https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/notebooklm-enterprise/docs/api-notebooks), 2026). Free, Plus, Pro and Ultra accounts have nothing official to call. As a result, every consumer integration you’ll find works around the app, not through it.

| | Gemini Notebook | Gemini API + File Search |
|---|---|---|
| How you use it | Web and mobile app | Your own code, with an API key |
| Citations | Inline, in the chat | Annotations with document parts and page numbers |
| Audio and video sources | Supported | Not supported |
| Studio outputs | Audio, video, slides, quizzes and more | You build them yourself |
| Cost | Free tier, then Google AI plans | Indexing embeddings plus model tokens |
| Size cap | Source limits per notebook, by plan | 100 MB per file, 1 GB total on the free tier |

How much does the NotebookLM API cost?
The only official one, the Gemini Notebook Enterprise API, needs Gemini Notebook for Enterprise licenses, which cost $9 per license per month after a 30-day trial, with a 15-license minimum. The Gemini API’s File Search charges for indexing and model tokens instead, and its storage is free.

title: Does Gemini Notebook (NotebookLM) Have an API? Every Route, Compared (November 2026)
snippet:
Gemini Notebook (formerly NotebookLM) now has a developer API, the Gemini Notebook API: a Public Preview for personal Google accounts, at no charge during the preview. It only creates notebooks and adds sources: it generates no content of any kind (no audio or video overviews, reports, mind maps, quizzes or slide decks) and cannot answer questions about your sources. The Enterprise API makes only audio overviews, for licensed users at $9 per license per month (minimum 15). The Podcast API is deprecated. Unofficial libraries and hosted services use your own account, at your risk; AutoContent API is an independent alternative.

| Gemini Notebook API (Google, Public Preview) | Nothing generated: it only creates, lists and updates notebooks, and adds web pages, YouTube videos, plain text and Markdown as sources. The API has no method for audio or video overviews, reports, mind maps, quizzes, infographics, slide decks or questions. A remote MCP server gives the same notebook and source tools. | No charge during the Public Preview. A personal Google account (Workspace accounts are not supported yet), a Google Cloud project and an OAuth 2.0 user token; the API takes no API keys. 100 requests per minute per project; 100 to 500 notebooks per user, by Google plan. | Low, with Preview terms. Google's own API in your Google Cloud project. Google can change or stop a Preview at any time, with no SLA. | From its docs, updated October 29 to November 2, 2026. Not run by us. |
| Gemini Notebook Enterprise API (Google) | Notebooks, sources and audio overviews, one per notebook at a time. The API has no video overview, slide deck or infographic, and no method to download the audio. | A Google Cloud project and a signed-in user with a Gemini Notebook Enterprise license. $9 per license per month, at least 15 licenses. 20 audio overviews per user per day. | Low, with Preview terms. Google's own API under your Google Cloud agreement. Google can change or stop a Preview at any time, with no SLA.
